Keen to add another string to her bow she studied for her MBA (Master’s Degree in Business Administration) at Oxford before joining the company in 1996. Over the years European Electronique has grown into the flourishing, market leading professional organisation it is today with a turnover approaching £75m. Yolanta’s drive, passion and determination has steered the company to unrivalled success in delivering ICT infrastructure into both Public and Private sectors. Although European Electronique is now a large, well established organisation with 30 years’ trading history, the company still retains a very customer focused business approach. Being privately owned European Electronique is an agile, dynamic and bureaucracy-free organisation where all the Board members are actively involved in the day-to-day running of the business.
